Neutral CVD and position near lower ATR band suggest potential support sweep or range consolidation.

Price is pushing down to Session Low 1.3307.

signals.rationale: Price is inside Value Area (VAL 28023.92 to VAH 28294.33), far above POC 28115.86. CVD is +9.20 (BULLISH) with positive slope (+0.91), agreeing with upward trend.
